The growth is owning both sides instead of splitting them.

readerCopy.body: The announcement promises access on a much larger scale than the current system can deliver. Leadership points to demand, reach, and public excitement, while operators point to waitlists, staffing, and costs that have already exceeded the original plan. The Sun defends the oversized public promise, while Jupiter makes the audience and the obligation grow together. The opposition places the inspiring promise directly across from the size of the obligation it creates. The program may still grow, but the gap between reach and capacity becomes the first problem expansion has to answer.
